en.headline: CK Asset to demolish three Anderson Road towers
en.dek: The Buildings Department has approved plans to take down three of six towers after steel bars departed from the approved drawings.
body: CK Asset said on Thursday it will demolish and rebuild three towers at its Anderson Road residential project in Kwun Tong, calling that the quicker option after steel bars were found not to have been installed to the standard required under the Buildings Ordinance.

The Buildings Department told Sing Tao that part of the reinforcement in all six towers had seriously departed from the approved plans. It has accepted a structural engineer's remedial scheme for three of them, withdrew stop-work orders in May so that work could start, and understands the repairs have been under way since then. For the other three, the department said it has received and approved demolition plans, but has not yet received an application to begin the demolition.

CK Asset said the department, after reviewing the works, found no obvious danger in the overall structure of the towers. Because each block is handled as a separate case, putting a repair scheme to the department takes investigation and argument and is very time-consuming. The group said its consultants spent nearly two years investigating three of the six buildings and producing remedial measures the department accepted. It then decided, on grounds of time and cost, that demolishing and rebuilding the remaining three would save the most time.

The developer also named China Railway Engineering (Hong Kong) as the new contractor for the project. The department said that in August 2025 it laid a total of 205 charges against the contractor, the authorized signatory and related technically competent persons over the installation of reinforcement.

zh.headline: 長實安達臣道三座大樓拆卸重建 屋宇署已批圖則
zh.dek: 屋宇署接納其中三幢補救方案，餘下三幢的拆卸圖則已獲批准，但尚未收到展開拆卸的申請。
body: 長實集團周四表示，觀塘安達臣道住宅項目其中三座大樓會拆卸重建。集團說，這是在鋼筋未按《建築物條例》標準安裝後，最節省時間的做法。
屋宇署回覆《星島》查詢時說，項目六幢大樓均有部分鋼筋配置嚴重偏離批准圖則，已要求專業人士提交補救方案。署方早前接納了結構工程師為其中三幢提交的方案，並於今年五月撤回停工令，以便補救工程展開，據了解工程已自同月陸續進行。餘下三幢，發展商計劃拆卸重建，署方已收到並批准拆卸圖則，惟至今未收到展開拆卸工程的申請。
長實回應查詢時說，屋宇署檢視工程後指出各大樓整體結構無明顯危險。由於每座大廈當作獨立個案處理，修補方案須經調查和論證，過程很耗時。集團說，工程顧問花了近兩年時間，為六座之中的三座做調查，並提出署方認可的修補措施；其後按效率和經濟效益研究，決定拆卸重建餘下三座，認為這是最節省時間的方案。
長實並公布，項目新承建商為中國鐵路工程（香港）有限公司。屋宇署表示，曾於2025年8月就鋼筋安裝問題，向承建商、獲授權簽署人及相關適任技術人員提出共205項檢控。
